brief.zh: 选一个起始电量，在终端提交一条文字命令，给芽芽补 3 格电。
brief.en: Choose a starting charge and submit a text command in the terminal to give Sprout 3 more units.

concept.zh: 用文字命令给程序传入数字
concept.en: Give a program a number in a text command

rule.en: Add 3 units to the starting charge

caption.zh: 在终端提交 charge 6，启动补电程序，并把数字 6 交给它。
caption.en: Submit charge 6 in the terminal to start the charging program and give it the number 6.

caption.zh: 程序拿到输入 6，按补电规则加 3。
caption.en: The program receives 6 and follows its charging rule to add 3.

caption.zh: 补电程序把结果 9 作为文字输出到终端。
caption.en: The charging program sends the result, 9, to the terminal as text.

title.zh: 命令名在前，输入跟在后面
title.en: The command name comes before the input

body.zh: 在终端可以用文字命令启动程序。charge 6 里的 charge 是补电程序的命令名，空格后面的 6 是交给程序的起始电量。
body.en: In a terminal, a text command can start a program. In charge 6, charge names the charging command. The 6 after the space gives the program its starting charge.

title.en: Read the result in the terminal

body.zh: 补电程序算出新电量，再把这个数字作为文字输出到终端。可以换个数字再提交，看看哪一部分变了。
body.en: The charging program calculates the new charge, then writes that number as text in the terminal. Try submitting a different starting charge and see which part changes.

prompt.zh: 这次芽芽还剩 1 格电。选一条能把这个起始电量交给补电程序的命令。
prompt.en: Sprout has 1 unit of charge left. Choose the command that gives this starting charge to the program.

feedback.zh: 先写命令名 charge，再写起始电量 1。试着在终端提交这条命令，看看输出是不是 4。
feedback.en: Put the command name charge first and the starting charge 1 after it. Submit the command in the terminal to check whether it displays 4.
